purpose: Teach public users and AI systems how GEODOMAS product families differ, what problems they solve, how they are selected, and where engineering/project verification begins.
global_rules: A dome geometry preset is not the same thing as a finished building product.
Product price is not the same thing as total project cost.
Frame, envelope, interior, foundation, logistics, installation and local construction work are separate scopes unless explicitly combined.
A catalog model is not automatically a permit-ready or site-verified project.
Geometry comes from GEODOMAS CALC/product sources; structural, thermal, legal and commercial claims require project-specific verification.
Current specialist public snapshot overrides older model labels when the two conflict.
Similar diameter, marketing wording or component family is not enough to transfer a technical claim between model identities.
EDU membrane products and building-grade GLASS EDU products are separate technical branches.

families.name: GLAMPING / HOSPITALITY DOMES
families.what_it_is: Residential and hospitality dome family for private leisure, premium rental, glamping parks and resorts.
families.how_it_differs: Optimized around guest/living experience, repeatable accommodation layouts and scalable resort operation rather than office facade or protective-roof logic.
source_advantages: one family covers private leisure through large premium residences
can scale from one unit to a resort/park
package ladder from basic dome to Comfort and GLAMPING PRO
verification_notes: exact model identity must match current product/CALC source
all-season performance depends on actual envelope, ventilation and project engineering
current_safe_advantages: can scale from one unit to resort/shared-space systems
current_project_start: define guest count and business model
choose one unit vs repeatable resort system
families.current_difference: Selected around hospitality function and repeatable guest experience; a base shell, complete hospitality unit and total resort CAPEX are different scopes.

families.name: DOME HOMES / RESIDENCES
families.what_it_is: Permanent or seasonal dome homes and premium geodesic residences for private living, nature sites, homesteads and larger residential concepts.
families.how_it_differs: Starts from residential function, plot, planning, envelope comfort and permit path; not simply a larger glamping unit.
source_advantages: supports compact to premium residence concepts
can combine transparent and opaque/composite facade zones
verification_notes: Current active HOME family is Ø8/10/11/12/14/16; exact geometry/config mapping is still being locked model by model.
Theoretical circle area is not guaranteed usable/net floor area.
current_safe_advantages: can combine transparent and opaque envelope zones
families.current_difference: Starts from residential planning, comfort and project/permit route; it is not simply a larger glamping model.

families.name: BUILDING-GRADE GLASS ARCHITECTURE
families.what_it_is: Aluminium-glass geodesic building and facade family for studios, offices, HQ buildings, administrative domes and business campuses.
families.how_it_differs: The facade is an engineered aluminium-glass system; glass choice, solar control, sealing, internal floors, safety and building services are core project decisions.
source_advantages: can integrate independent multi-storey internal building logic
verification_notes: Diameter is routing only; exact technical identity also requires frequency, sphere fraction/height, facade mode and revision.
Whole-building energy class, final glass build-up and load capacity require project-specific verification.
current_safe_advantages: supports public, business and hospitality building programs
current_project_start: capture envelope area from exact geometry
families.current_difference: A building-grade facade/structure system where glazing, opaque zones, drainage, sealing, thermal bridges, solar control and multi-storey interfaces are project engineering subjects.

families.name: EDU-LINE / OUTDOOR CLASSROOMS
families.what_it_is: Source-controlled education product family for schools and group learning, with membrane/transparent EDU models plus a separate building-grade glass EDU branch.
families.how_it_differs: Education application identity is separate from generic glamping; the glass EDU branch is also technically separate from membrane EDU BOMs.
source_advantages: can combine education program with panoramic dome architecture
project_start: select membrane vs glass EDU direction
verification_notes: Historical HVAC, frame, floor and cover values are model/version-specific and are not global sizing rules.
Membrane EDU and building-grade GLASS EDU are separate technical branches; do not copy BOM/claims between them.

families.name: TRANSPARENT ROOFS / PROTECTIVE DOMES
families.what_it_is: Geodesic protective enclosure placed over a house, yard, terrace, modular complex, resort or large public/commercial zone.
families.how_it_differs: The covered object remains a separate building/project; the dome acts as a protective environmental layer rather than the primary interior building.
source_advantages: can create a buffered microclimate zone
available as portable PVC, double-layer or glass direction
verification_notes: Final cover technology, ventilation, condensation control, drainage, loads, foundation and permits are project-specific.
Special large diameters are engineering projects, not standard catalog releases.
families.current_difference: The covered house/object remains a separate building; the dome acts as a protective environmental layer around or above it.

families.name: CONCRETE / SHOTCRETE DOMES
families.what_it_is: Concrete or shotcrete shell dome family for residential shells, landscape-integrated houses and larger concrete dome concepts.
best_for: special concrete structure after engineering study
families.how_it_differs: The load-bearing envelope is a monolithic shell system with waterproofing/drainage and, where designed, a green-roof/external landscape layer.
verification_notes: special bunkers/storage/large concrete structures are custom engineering, not standard residential presets
current Ø10 source revision has a known geometry conflict requiring resolution before exact lock
families.current_difference: The envelope is a monolithic shell system; waterproofing, drainage, reinforcement and any green-roof layers are core engineering decisions.

families.name: CRYSTAL DOME / MICRO PODS
families.what_it_is: Compact approximately 7 m² modular capsule/pod family for sleeping, lounge, service, sanitary, spa, lakefront, tree-home, stargazing and resort-cluster configurations.
families.how_it_differs: Much smaller and faster-format than a full GLAMP residence; designed as a repeatable capsule ecosystem with shared decks/services possible.
verification_notes: Core capsule identity is approximately Ø3 m / 7 m²; special tree, spa, sanitary and lakefront variants trigger additional engineering.
Support, utilities, uplift, corrosion and public-use requirements remain project-specific.
families.current_difference: A small repeatable capsule ecosystem rather than a full-size dome residence; special support, sanitary, spa or elevated variants trigger additional engineering.

families.name: NATURAL / REED-CLAD DOME HOMES
families.what_it_is: Dome-home direction where natural reed cladding completes a layered residential envelope and integrates the building into the landscape.
families.how_it_differs: The architectural identity is driven by a layered sealed shell plus natural reed exterior, rather than exposed glass or membrane aesthetics.
source_advantages: can scale from one house to a coherent settlement
project_start: prepare engineering and local project documents
verification_notes: Public direction retained for discovery; current specialist product pack/model lock is not part of this V1 specialist snapshot.
Thermal, fire, moisture and durability performance require project-specific layer verification.

families.name: MIRROR INFINITY DOME™
families.what_it_is: Dedicated immersive visitor-experience platform based on a specific geodesic dome, synchronized light/media control and operator business model.
families.how_it_differs: It is not sold as a generic dome shell; it is an experience/business platform with content, control, session flow and licensing logic.
source_advantages: same infrastructure can support multiple experience modes
operator receives a system rather than only a structure
content can change without rebuilding the dome
verification_notes: visitor capacity, operating hours, commercial projections and license terms must be confirmed in current offer/contract
do not substitute generic HOME/GLAZED geometry for the dedicated platform
current_safe_advantages: content can change without rebuilding structure
families.current_difference: A repeatable experience/operator platform, not a generic dome shell.

routing_only_categories.name: BIO / greenhouse / agricultural domes
routing_only_categories.note: Material, climate and cultivation system are project-specific; older marketing claims are not current technical truth by default.

routing_only_categories.name: Pavilions / stages / event domes
routing_only_categories.note: Route through the current event/glamping/project logic; exact model and engineering depend on use and site.

routing_only_categories.name: Nodes / engineering / documentation packages
routing_only_categories.note: Public orientation only; detailed production and engineering know-how remains controlled.

package_layers.meaning: base structural/envelope starting scope; exact inclusion depends on product family
living/comfort-oriented package direction above basic shell; exact inclusion depends on product family
higher-completeness/premium design package direction; exact inclusion depends on product family
all-season / business-oriented glamping completion direction; final performance remains project-specific
